cases.behavior: Build can record real managed checks and Verify reuses only matching successful evidence.
cases.reproduction: Execute Build checks, submit a candidate, then verify unchanged inputs, edited inputs, and a later failed Build check.
cases.expected: Reuse unchanged successful evidence and rerun edited or superseded evidence.
cases.forbidden: Treat terminal summaries or superseded successes as current Runtime checks.
cases.rootCause: Build lacked a managed check step before candidate submission.

cases.behavior: New public Runs omit redundant Builder review and unused recovery templates.
cases.reproduction: Create through native new and claim the Builder through runtime dispatch. Legacy factory fixtures retain the historical protocol assertions.
cases.expected: Return one receipt result without a duplicate acceptanceReview or unused failure/recovery requests.
cases.forbidden: Drop required Verify acceptance coverage or alter existing Run templates.
cases.rootCause: Healthy handoffs expanded alternative protocols and repeated the full acceptance review.

cases.behavior: Verifier results wait directly for acceptance even when the reading report cannot be written.
cases.reproduction: Submit the real Verifier result using CLI dispatch, including a directory occupying verification.md, then remove it and call next.
cases.expected: Keep the saved verdict and acceptance wait, retry rendering without another report Action.
cases.forbidden: Rollback a successful verdict, auto-approve acceptance, or advance revision merely to render the report.
cases.rootCause: Report rendering was a separate workflow Action required before acceptance.
